description: Synthetic everyday (common-disease) cases written for evaluation of the realist agent's common-condition fallback. Written from scratch in the style of a clinic note. Gold labels are names from app/clinical.py COMMON_CONDITIONS. also_ok lists clinically acceptable alternatives (used for the lenient score). Difficulty: typical or partial (fewer cues / overlapping symptoms).
author: synthetic, 2026-11-24

cases.text: A 26-year-old woman with a runny nose, sneezing, sore throat and mild cough for two days. Low-grade fever. No breathlessness.
A 40-year-old man with sudden high fever, body aches, chills, headache and dry cough since yesterday. Feels exhausted.
A 19-year-old student with a very sore throat, pain on swallowing, fever and swollen tender neck glands for three days. Tonsils are red with white patches. No cough.
A 35-year-old woman with blocked nose, thick yellow-green nasal discharge, facial pain over the cheeks that is worse bending forward, and headache for ten days after a cold.
A 45-year-old man with a productive cough for nine days after a cold, mild wheeze and chest soreness from coughing. No fever now, breathing normal at rest.
A 67-year-old man with fever, cough with rusty sputum, shortness of breath and sharp chest pain on deep breathing for three days. Crackles at the right lung base.
A 22-year-old woman with episodes of wheeze, chest tightness and night-time cough, worse with exercise and cold air. She had eczema as a child.
A 28-year-old man with sneezing fits, itchy watery eyes, runny nose and blocked nose every spring, worse outdoors. No fever.
A 12-year-old boy with red, itchy, watery eyes in both eyes for two days. Classmates have the same. Vision normal.
A 4-year-old girl with ear pain, tugging at her right ear, fever and irritability after a cold. Not sleeping well.
A 30-year-old woman with vomiting, watery diarrhoea and abdominal cramps since last night after eating at a wedding. Mild fever.
A 50-year-old man with burning chest pain after meals and when lying down, sour taste in the mouth and acidity for months. Worse after spicy food and tea.
A 42-year-old woman with gnawing upper abdominal pain, bloating and nausea, worse on an empty stomach and eased by food. She takes ibuprofen often for back pain.
A 27-year-old woman with abdominal pain relieved by opening her bowels, bloating, and alternating constipation and diarrhoea for over a year, worse with stress. Weight is stable.
A 60-year-old woman with hard, infrequent stools twice a week, straining and a feeling of incomplete emptying for months. Low fibre diet, drinks little water.
A 25-year-old woman with burning when passing urine, going to the toilet very often and lower abdominal discomfort for two days. No fever or back pain.
A 38-year-old man with sudden severe colicky pain in the left flank radiating to the groin, can't sit still, with nausea and blood in the urine.
A 52-year-old overweight man with increased thirst, passing urine a lot including at night, tiredness and blurred vision for two months. Father had diabetes.
A 44-year-old woman with tiredness, weight gain, feeling cold all the time, dry skin, constipation, hair thinning and heavy periods over six months.
A 31-year-old woman with weight loss despite eating more, palpitations, shaky hands, sweating, feeling hot and anxious, and loose stools for three months.
A 29-year-old woman with heavy periods, tiredness, breathlessness on stairs, pale skin and brittle nails. She craves ice.
A 55-year-old man with occasional morning headaches. Blood pressure 162/98 and 158/96 on two visits. Smoker, overweight, eats a lot of salt.
A 34-year-old office worker with a tight band-like headache around the forehead most afternoons, worse with stress and long hours at the computer, with neck stiffness. No vomiting.
A 24-year-old woman with recurrent one-sided throbbing headaches lasting a day, with nausea, sensitivity to light and noise, preceded by flashing zig-zag lights. Her mother has similar headaches.
A 58-year-old woman with brief spinning dizziness lasting seconds when she turns over in bed or looks up. No hearing loss. Feels fine between episodes.
A 40-year-old man with lower back pain after lifting heavy boxes three days ago, worse with bending and better lying down. No leg numbness or bladder problems.
A 63-year-old woman with painful knees worse on climbing stairs and walking, stiffness for ten minutes in the morning and creaking. Overweight.
A 45-year-old woman with painful swollen joints in the fingers and wrists on both sides and morning stiffness lasting over an hour for three months. Tiredness.
A 50-year-old man woke at night with a red, hot, extremely painful swollen big toe joint. He had a party with alcohol and meat the evening before.
A 52-year-old woman with shoulder pain and stiffness for three months, cannot reach behind her back or comb her hair, pain at night lying on that side. She has diabetes.
A 6-year-old boy with itchy dry red patches in the elbow and knee creases that come and go, worse in winter. Mild asthma and hay fever.
A 30-year-old woman with raised itchy red welts all over her body that come and go within hours, started after eating prawns. No breathing difficulty.
A 35-year-old man with an itchy red ring-shaped rash with a scaly edge in the groin and inner thighs for weeks, worse with sweating in hot weather.
A 16-year-old girl with pimples, blackheads and some tender red spots on her face and upper back for a year, worse before periods.
A 33-year-old woman worrying excessively about everything for six months, restless, tense, poor concentration, palpitations and difficulty falling asleep.
A 41-year-old man with low mood, loss of interest in things he used to enjoy, poor sleep, tiredness, poor appetite and feeling worthless for two months.
A 17-year-old girl with cramping lower abdominal pain on the first two days of every period, with back ache and nausea. Periods regular.
A 23-year-old woman with irregular periods every two to three months, acne, excess hair on the face and chin, and weight gain.
A 62-year-old diabetic man with chest tightness when walking uphill that goes away within five minutes of rest. Smoker, high cholesterol.
A 72-year-old woman with increasing breathlessness on walking, needs three pillows at night, swollen ankles and weight gain over three weeks. Previous heart attack.
Cough, sore throat and runny nose for 3 days. Child, 7 years.
Burning urine and going often. 60-year-old woman, mild lower tummy pain.
Loose motions and vomiting since morning, stomach cramps. 9-year-old boy.
Recurrent headaches with nausea and light sensitivity, 30-year-old woman.

cases.gold: Dengue / other acute febrile illness (endemic areas)
cases.text: A 26-year-old man in the monsoon season with high fever for four days, severe pain behind the eyes, body and joint aches and a faint rash. Platelets slightly low.
A 48-year-old vegetarian woman with tiredness, tingling in the feet, aching bones and muscle weakness. Little sun exposure.
